confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from reconnaissance and failed login attempts to a successful unauthorized login, followed by privilege escalation, bulk exfiltration of sensitive finance data, and anti-forensic log deletion. All actions originated from a single external IP (185.220.101.34) that does not match the user's baseline.

attack_chain.description: Reconnaissance: Unauthorized access attempts to the admin login page from external IP 185.220.101.34.
Brute force/Credential testing: Multiple failed login attempts for user_04 from the external IP.
Unauthorized Access: Successful login for user_04 from an unusual external IP (185.220.101.34) during off-hours.
Privilege Escalation: user_04 successfully escalated their role from 'read_only' to 'read_write'.
Data Exfiltration: Bulk download of multiple highly sensitive files from the /data/finance/confidential/ directory.
Anti-Forensics: Deletion of the file access log to hide traces of the activity.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_04's actual credentials were compromised or if the account was bypassed via a vulnerability.
Verification of whether the external IP 185.220.101.34 is associated with a known VPN or Tor exit node.
narrative: An external actor using IP 185.220.101.34 successfully compromised the account of user_04 (a junior accountant) after several failed login attempts. The attacker escalated privileges to 'read_write' and exfiltrated a large volume of confidential financial documents before deleting access logs to cover their tracks.
